definitions.explanation: a Japanese rice bowl dish consisting of sliced beef and onion simmered in a sweet-savory sauce, served over rice

examples.japanese: {牛丼|ぎゅうどん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}する→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
⟦{昼|ひる}→昼：00540_hiru⟧ごはん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I had a beef bowl for lunch.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牛丼|ぎゅうどん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たっぷり→たっぷり：03404_tappuri⟧⟦{乗|の}っている→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: The beef bowl at this restaurant is generously topped with meat.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
{牛丼|ぎゅうどん} is a staple of cheap, fast eating: the chains {吉野家|よしのや}, すき{家|や}, and {松屋|まつや} serve it at counters nationwide within a minute or two of ordering.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牛丼|ぎゅうどん}⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧: beef-bowl restaurant
- {牛丼|ぎゅうどん}チェーン: beef-bowl chain
- ⟦{並盛|なみも}り→並盛り：15015_namimori⟧ / ⟦{大盛|おおも}り→大盛り：08162_oomori⟧ / ⟦{特盛|とくも}り→特盛り：15014_tokumori⟧: regular / large / extra-large (the standard size choices)
- つゆだく: with extra sauce (ordering slang)

RELATED WORDS:
Other rice bowls ending in 〜{丼|どん}: ⟦{親子丼|おやこどん}→親子丼：17621_oyakodon⟧ (chicken and egg), カツ{丼|どん} (pork cutlet), ⟦{天丼|てんどん}→天丼：19279_tendon⟧ (tempura), ⟦{豚丼|ぶたどん}→豚丼：22328_butadon⟧ (pork).
